in_marathi.name: Badsah
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Badsah हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bada’ meaning ‘Lord’ and ‘Sah’ meaning ‘Fortune’, the name Badsah represents the one who is the ruler of fortune and prosperity. In Hindu mythology, the god Vishnu is often referred to as Badsah, the one who bestows wealth and happiness upon his devotees.
